circuit_breaker._selection_rationale: 5/30/30 chosen for Availability priority (W_Avail=4.1182). Not globally optimal: 10/60/60 achieves W_Quality=4.2143 and W_Economy=4.0672. See sensitivity_results_v3.csv.
circuit_breaker._data_split: runIndex=1 used for CB tuning only. runIndex=2..5 used for evaluation. Prevents Tuning/Test Leakage.
circuit_breaker._architecture_note: Piper is used while CB is OPEN (routed directly) or as hard-failure fallback. HALF-OPEN sends a recovery probe to ElevenLabs only; if probe succeeds CB returns CLOSED, if probe fails CB returns OPEN.

_architecture_note: Adaptive is a Fault-Resilience Router only. Routes to Piper via CB OPEN on hard failures. HALF-OPEN routes solely to ElevenLabs as a probe. No latency routing.
